correctness.rationale: For all \(n\ge3\), mirrored first/last triples are forced by three- and four-factor conservation, and the six four-factor antisymmetric differences are \((0,-h,h,-h,0,-h)\), with \(h=N(0011)-N(1100)\). The transfer matrix enumerates the \(h=0\) words, with determinant \(1-2z+(2-t-t^{-1})z^6\) and exactly computed reversal trace. Constant-term extraction gives the claimed radical generating function. Its sole dominant singularity is \(1/2\), since \(1-2z+4z^6\) has no root of modulus at most \(1/2\). Direct exhaustive enumeration for \(n\le16\) and exact symbolic matrix algebra are confirmed by verify.py; these are checks, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial binary level-four \(k\)-abelian reversal language has a full recognition criterion, an explicit algebraic generating function, and a universal \(2^n/\sqrt{n}\) asymptotic density. The result goes beyond endpoint conditions and generic transfer-matrix existence by reducing six antisymmetric constraints to one exact balance and evaluating the Laurent constant term. The quantified object is motivated directly by the \(k\)-abelian palindrome literature; this is an infinite exact natural invariant, not an arbitrary finite slice.
